responsibility: Provides rustc’s incremental dependency-graph assertion and visualization support used by tests and debugging. It scans crate items for `#[rustc_if_this_changed]` and `#[rustc_then_this_would_need]` annotations, resolves them to dep-nodes, checks whether the requested paths exist in the final query dependency graph after codegen, emits the corresponding diagnostics for expected or missing edges, and can dump filtered dep-graph data in text and Graphviz forms for inspection.
